CR.label: Official historical tourism flows, with direction-specific scope
CR.inboundMetricLabel: International overnight tourist arrivals by nationality, all modes
CR.inboundScope: All individually identified countries in ICT Annual Statistical Tourism2025 Table1, PDF pages3–4
CR.inboundNote: Official ICT processing of Directorate-General of Migration and Foreigners passport records. Overnight nonresident tourists; excludes Costa Ricans, foreign residents, temporary work permits, cruise passengers, crew and land transport workers. Nationality classification. Most Puerto Rico arrivals are included under United States because of passport classification. Other-market and regional aggregates omitted.
CR.outboundMetricLabel: Costa Rican air departures by reported country headed to (connections included)
CR.outboundScope: All individually named countries in ICT Annual Statistical Tourism2025 PartII Table2; air only
CR.outboundNote: The source explicitly warns that the immigration officer records the country the traveller is heading to, which is not necessarily the final destination and mostly corresponds to countries with direct air connections from Costa Rica. These are multi-purpose departures of Costa Rican nationals, not unique holidaymakers. Land departures, regional totals and other-country groups are not included in these country ranks.

CO.inboundMetricLabel: Foreign nonresident visitor arrivals by country of residence
CO.inboundScope: All identifiable residence countries/territories in official government monthly dataset, summed over January–December2025
CO.inboundNote: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism calculations from Migración Colombia. Annual sums across monthly department/city records, grouped by foreign visitor country of residence. Covers foreign nonresidents, not Colombians living abroad or cruise passenger totals. From January2020, Venezuelan-resident foreigners are included only when the reported purpose is rest/recreation. Explicit uninhabited-area labels and unallocated/non-country rows are excluded from market ranks, retained in audit.

DO.inboundScope: All individually named markets in BCRD2025 national-total panel; foreign nonresidents only
DO.inboundNote: BCRD workbook based on Ministry of Tourism e-ticket information, national panel only. Source workbook stores fractional allocation/estimation values; precision is retained rather than presented as exact integer headcounts. Regional and Others aggregates omitted. Do not add airport panels to national totals.
